evaluation_boundary: Do not pass or merge this unit until the remote branch readback equals the exact local head and all required exact-head checks for that unchanged SHA succeed. CI is internal evidence and cannot establish AGI.
expected_outputs: One local commit SHA whose tree contains the complete migration and no generated debug artifacts
One remote branch whose exact SHA equals the local publication SHA
One pull request or verified reuse of an existing exact-head pull request
Exact-head workflow/check identifiers and current conclusions
Updated heartbeat, publication state, continuation, and retained negative evidence
goal: Publish the validated Work-mode migration as one isolated immutable branch head, create or reuse exactly one pull request, and obtain exact-head CI identifiers and status without weakening the AGI gate or duplicating external effects.
inputs: The final locally validated migration worktree and native O invocation journal
Current remote branches, open pull requests, and exact-head checks
The user's durable authorization for branch, commit, push, PR, checks, and merge under safe conditions
scope: Git commit and remote branch for the current migration worktree
